% LaTeX's \newtheorem with hyperref but without amsmath, whose
% \ifmeasuring@ hyperref's \MakeLinkTarget tests. The theorem's link leads
% where a \ref to it leads.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:one}A numbered theorem.\end{theorem}
Theorem~\ref{thm:one} is numbered.
\end{document}
